done_when: forge decision accept on a sign-off decision with no approval details yet runs the strict sign-off review and stops without accepting, saying the review passed and the sign-off email can go out (or naming the gaps); with the reply recorded, it accepts as today; tests run both through forge decision accept

findings.body: The guide tells users to run `forge decision accept` both before and after the customer's reply, but that command requires a slug and `--by` (`src/forge/records.py:505-509`). Following either instruction produces a usage error. Show the full command, such as `forge decision accept client-signoff --by "<name>"`, in both places.
findings.title: Give the runnable sign-off command in the guide

why: The sign-off review runs only when the customer's reply is recorded, so the customer is asked to approve a version that hasn't passed review
